name: Spacer
description: Empty layout element that injects a fixed gap on a single axis. Used inside flex/grid containers where adding a token-sized gap as a sibling reads cleaner than the gap utility.

ariaRequirements: Renders as a non-interactive `<div>`; assistive tech ignores it.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Bucket-1 beta port: keyboard/ARIA contract reviewed, ForcedColors story added, Storybook axe gate (parameters.a11y.test: error).

forbiddenUse: Stack two Spacers — collapse them into the larger size.
Use as a 'push' element to right-align content — use flex `margin-inline-start: auto` instead.
dense: Fixed aria-hidden gap block: size xs 8|sm 16|md 24 (default)|lg 32|xl 48|2xl 64px, axis vertical|horizontal; escape hatch when the parent's gap can't be changed

usage.description: Spacer inserts a fixed, aria-hidden gap where you cannot control the parent's layout — between blocks you don't own, or in markup that isn't a Stack. It is the escape hatch, not the default: prefer gap on Stack/FlexBox/Grid first. `axis="horizontal"` makes it a width in inline rows.

bestPractices.description: Reach for parent gap first (Stack/FlexBox/Grid); use Spacer only where you cannot own the parent.
Use axis="horizontal" inside flex rows; the default vertical axis is for block flow.
Pick the one size that matches the rhythm step you need — sizes map to the space scale.
Keep it aria-hidden (built in); it must never carry content or semantics.
Do not stack multiple Spacers to add up space — use the next size.
Do not use Spacer for page-band rhythm; Section's spacing prop owns that.
